1.text: Nuko Sawuli aratanga. Kandi Dawidi atabarutse avuye kwica Abamaleki, ageze i Sikulagi ahasibira kabiri.

2.text: Ku munsi wa gatatu haza umugabo uvuye mu rugerero rwa Sawuli, ashishimuye imyenda ye, yisīze umukungugu mu mutwe, ageze kuri Dawidi yikubita hasi aramuramya.

3.text: Dawidi aramubaza ati “Uraturuka he?”Aramusubiza ati “Ncitse ku icumu mu rugerero rw'Abisirayeli.”

4.text: Dawidi aramubaza ati “Byagenze bite? Ndakwinginze mbwira.” Aramusubiza ati “Abantu bahunze ku rugamba, kandi benshi muri bo baguye mu ntambara barapfa. Sawuli na Yonatani umuhungu we na bo barapfuye.”

5.text: Dawidi abaza uwo muhungu wamubikiye ati “Ariko wabibwiwe n'iki ko Sawuli na Yonatani umuhungu we bapfuye?”

6.text: Uwo muhungu wamubikiraga aravuga ati “Narigenderaga ngeze ku musozi w'i Gilibowa, mbona Sawuli yishita ku icumu, kandi mbona amagare n'abahetswe n'amafarashi bamusatiriye.

7.text: Maze Sawuli akebutse inyuma arambona, arampamagara ndamwitaba nti ‘Karame.’

8.text: Arambaza ati ‘Uri nde?’ Ndamusubiza nti ‘Ndi Umwamaleki.’

9.text: Arambwira ati ‘Nyamuna igira hano unsonge, dore ndembejwe n'umubabaro, kuko nkiri muzima.’

10.text: Nuko ndamwegera, ndamusonga kuko nari menye neza ko atakiri uwo gukira, namara kugwa. Mperako mucuza ikamba ryari ku mutwe n'umuringa wari ku kuboko, none mbizaniye databuja.”

11.text: Dawidi afata imyenda ye arayishishimura, n'abari kumwe na we bose babigenza batyo.

12.text: Bacura umuborogo bararira, biyiriza ubusa bageza nimugoroba, bababajwe na Sawuli n'umuhungu we Yonatani kandi n'abantu b'Uwiteka n'inzu ya Isirayeli, kuko bicishijwe inkota.

13.text: Dawidi abaza uwo muhungu wamubikiye ati “Uri uwa he?”Ati “Ndi umwana w'Umwamaleki w'umunyamahanga.”

14.text: Dawidi aramubaza ati “Ni iki cyatumye udatinya, ugahangara kuramburira ukuboko kwica umuntu Uwiteka yimikishije amavuta?”

15.text: Dawidi ahamagara umwe wo mu basore ati “Mwegere umusumire.” Aramusogota arapfa.

16.text: Dawidi aramubwira ati “Amaraso yawe abe ari wowe aba ku mutwe, kuko akanwa kawe ari ko muhamya nk'uko uvuze ngo ‘Nishe uwo Uwiteka yimikishije amavuta.’ ”

17.text: Nuko Dawidi aborogera Sawuli n'umuhungu we Yonatani uyu muborogo,

18.text: abategeka kwigisha Abayuda indirimbo y'umuheto, yanditswe mu gitabo cya Yashari.

19.text: “Icyubahiro cyawe, Isirayeli,Cyiciwe mu mpinga z'imisozi!Erega abanyambaraga baraguye!

20.text: Ntimuzabivuge muri Gati,Ntimuzabyamamaze mu nzira z'Abashikeloni,Abakobwa b'Abafilisitiya batanezerwa,Abakobwa b'abatakebwe be kwishimagiza.

21.text: “Mwa misozi y'i Gilibowa mwe,Kuri mwe ntihagatonde ikime, ntihakagwe imvura,Ntihakabe imirima yera imyaka y'amaturo,Kuko ari ho ingabo y'umunyambaraga yagwanye umugayo,Ni yo ngabo ya Sawuli, nk'iyo utimikishijwe amavuta.

22.text: Umuheto wa Yonatani ntiwasubiraga inyuma,Ngo uve ku maraso y'abishwe,No ku banyambaraga b'ibihangange,Kandi inkota ya Sawuli ntiyavukaga.

23.text: “Sawuli na Yonatani bari beza,Bafite igikundiro bakiriho,Kandi mu ipfa ryabo ntibaguye ukubiri.Bari abanyamuvumbuko kurusha ikizu,Bari abanyamaboko kurusha intare.

24.text: “Bakobwa ba Isirayeli, nimuririre Sawuli,Wabambikaga imyenda y'imihemba yo kurimbana,Warimbishaga imyambaro yanyu izahabu.

25.text: “Erega abanyambaraga baguye mu ntambara hagati!Yonatani yiciwe mu mpinga z'imisozi yawe.

26.text: “Unteye agahinda mwene data Yonatani,Wambereye uw'igikundiro bihebuje.Urukundo wankundaga rwari igitangaza,Rwarutaga urukundo rw'abagore.
